arguments.query: SELECT event_id, status, payload FROM outbox ORDER BY event_id

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, b.flight_id, b.passenger_id, COUNT(c.charge_id) as charge_count, GROUP_CONCAT(c.status) as charge_statuses FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id GROUP BY b.booking_id
SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, COUNT(c.charge_id) as charge_count FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id GROUP BY b.booking_id
SELECT booking_id, status FROM bookings ORDER BY booking_id
SELECT charge_id, booking_id, amount_cents FROM charges ORDER BY booking_id
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, status FROM bookings GROUP BY status

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, COALESCE(h.hold_id, NO_HOLD) as hold_id, COUNT(c.charge_id) as charge_count FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id GROUP BY b.booking_id HAVING charge_count = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT booking_id) as booking_count_with_holds FROM holds
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT booking_id) as booking_count_with_charges FROM charges
SELECT COUNT(*) as checkin_count FROM checkins
SELECT event_id, status, payload FROM outbox WHERE status IN (pending, quarantined) LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) as problematic_count FROM outbox WHERE status != "delivered"
